messages:
Maya (Design): dropping a fresh mock — new compact pill that stacks token count over fiat in the spend row. aim is to reduce wrapping and let users scan totals faster. persistent mini-actions area next to scope selector for invoice/export. fig link in thread.
Eric (PM): this looks promising. main requirement from finance: invoice download must be obvious and keyboard-accessible. how will the mini-actions behave on narrow widths?
Maya (Design): desktop -> small icon+label next to scope. <=980px -> actions become full-width button in the header. will provide both variants.
Sam (FE): implementation note: collapsing the rail to icon+label at <980px is doable. ensure focus order remains logical — scope -> invoice -> filters.
Lina (Eng): perf note: if the table has thousands of rows, sticky elements can trigger reflow. we should virtualize rows and only have one sticky container.
Ryan (Design Lead): visual polish: add a subtle 1px divider between the sparkline and the token pill. bump token numerals to 14px medium for legibility. softened bg for the pill.
Olivia (Content): CTA copy suggestion: "Download invoice (PDF / CSV)". aria-label: "Download billing invoice for selected scope and period". tooltip for token pill: "Tokens used (includes cached & prefix reuse)".
a11y-bot: Reminder: scope toggle must expose aria-pressed and invoice button needs a clear aria-label. ensure invoice is reachable within two tab stops from the scope control.
Maya (Design): noted. microcopy under total: "Invoice • PDF / CSV" as a small secondary label. will add aria notes in spec.
Sam (FE): for the token pill, we currently get fiat only in expanded view. propose lazy-loading fiat on hover/tap or using a show_fiat flag so we don't bloat payloads. also will add aria-expanded on tap for mobile toggles.
Lina (Eng): backend okay to add show_fiat query flag. suggest default server-side behavior for first page, and lazy-load for large datasets. will coordinate with api team to keep payloads reasonable.
Eric (PM): sprint decision: prioritize accessibility and invoice discoverability this sprint. compact preference (user setting) and lazy fiat improvements next sprint.
Maya (Design): action items: update Figma with divider, stronger token contrast, and mobile header CTA; include aria annotations.
Sam (FE): I'll draft component props: TokenPill({ compact: true, showFiat: boolean }), PersistentActions, keyboard sequence docs.
Lina (Eng): I'll add virtualization plan and API flag proposal.
Olivia (Content): I'll finalize CTA strings and localization keys.
Ryan (Design Lead): I'll review updated mock and sign off.
Eric (PM): acceptance criteria for this sprint: invoice download within two tab stops of scope toggle; mobile header includes invoice CTA; aria-labels present; no unnecessary fiat payload on large table loads.
Maya (Design): added to agenda for tomorrow's design review. please drop any remaining nits in the fig link. :thumbsup:
